description: Submits the wallet's signatures for a quote; gasrescue broadcasts the transaction, pays the gas and waits up to 3 minutes for the result. This moves funds and cannot be undone: call it only after the user approved the quote summary. A transfer can be submitted once; a second call is refused. Give signatures for EVM and Tron, signedTransaction for Solana, or for a gas drop fund: true with fundSignature and then txs. Returns { summary, transfer } with status confirmed or failed, the transaction hash and the explorer link.

fund.description: Gas drop (kind "evm-transactions") only: true asks gasrescue to send the wallet the gas for its two transfers. Needs fundSignature. Returns status funded.

fundSignature.description: Gas drop only, with fund: true: the sender wallet's personal_sign signature of funding.message from get_signing_request, as hex. Without it no gas is sent.

signatures.description: EVM and Tron: one signature per step of get_signing_request, in the same order, as hex strings.

signedTransaction.description: Solana only: the transaction from get_signing_request, signed by the sender, base64.

transferId.description: The id gasrescue returned as transfer.id from quote_send or quote_swap: 24 lowercase hex characters, e.g. "b39f46001a5680455091152d". Not a transaction hash and not an id of another service.

txs.description: Gas drop only: the hashes of the transactions the wallet sent, { fee, transfer }. gasrescue checks them on chain; the transfer closes the quote.

name: submit_signatures
title: Submit signatures and send
